snippet.title: Teen Titans: One-on-One (Full Gameplay)
snippet.description:
Hey everyone! I'm back with another video. This was requested by a subscriber a while back and I'm finally here to deliver. 

Since Flash isn't supported anymore, I'm using an archive called Flashpoint Infinity. This is an archive of flash games on the internet ready to play on the go. Here's the link to Flashpoint by BlueMaxima. Go to downloads and click the version you'd like! 

You can download it here: https://bluemaxima.org/flashpoint/

For some reason, the intructions got skipped when I tried to display them, so I'll put description them here along with some tips.

Raven- Your goal is to use the mouse to click, hold and destroy the falling objects from the Skyscraper. If you let them fall, you're penalized by losing health (the game says they hit people below. ouch!). Once you get to Overload, destroy the objects he hurls at you and when he's open, douse him with the water containers, his Weakness Overload. Try to hit him twice in one go if you can.

Cyborg- You have to chase down Atlas while avoiding/destroying his projectiles. Use the mouse to move Cyborg and the right-click to shoot. Once you reach Atlas, just shoot at him and don't worry about your health. He'll go down after several hits.

Starfire- You need to chase Mumbo while avoiding his magic projectiles in the city. Use the mouse to guide Starfire and the right-click to fire Blasts. Starfire's Charged Shots destroy everything (except the black saws) in one blast while her smaller shot destroy only one. When you reach Mumbo, you need to follow a patten because his attacks will track you. Just keep firing and dodging and you'll be good. It's easier said than done and this level's boss fight is somewhat difficult.

Beast Boy- He has the longest level. Use the arrow keys to move and the Up arrow key to jump. You must chase down Mad Mod as he's escaping through the bulilding. Utilize Beast Boy's morphing skills by pressing these buttons: 
1: Changes Beast Boy back to normal and allows you to activate switches. 
2: Changes Beast Boy into a Jaguar (or a Cheetah idk) and increases your running speed. Also, it allows you to take down robots. 
3: Changes Beast Boy into a Hawk and allows you to maneuver through tight spaces and dodge projectiles easily. 
If you lose, you repeat the level.

Robin- You have to chase down Red X down the Highway while avoiding bots, helicopters, and UFO's firing at you. Use the mouse to guide Robin and click to shoot. However, don't shoot too much or Robin's motorcycle will overheat and have delayed firing. Use the cars with the glowing rear windows to shoot down the UFO's and Helicopters if you can. When you reach Red X, carefully move around and shoot down the vehicles. Red X will always aim at you so watch him and the vehicle projectiles. After you destroy the other, shoot down the final vehicle and you'll win. The level itself isn't too difficult but the boss can give you some trouble.
